prompt_fragment: This asset is a background or texture. Prioritize atmosphere and surface coherence over a single isolated subject.
raw_description:
A cathedral stained-glass window pane. A single luminous aurora-
crystal held aloft, radiating concentric rings of light outward.
Emerald green and cyan glass panels fill the entire frame edge-to-
edge corner-to-corner, with a white radiant center. Thick black lead
lines divide the glass. Symbol of witness, memory, and echoing
testimony.
formatted_prompt:
STYLE: Cathedral stained-glass window pane, editorial field-journal ink and watercolor beneath, 19th-century naturalist plate aesthetic rendered in lead-divided jewel-toned glass panels; Gothic rose-window composition centered in a square frame, thick black lead lines dividing the glass, painterly glass-on-light register; aged parchment grain and faint foxing at the frame edges

SUBJECT: A single luminous aurora-crystal held aloft at the center of the pane, faceted and angular, radiating concentric rings of light outward in expanding arcs; the rings diminish in intensity toward the outer edges of the frame, suggesting echoing testimony and accumulated memory; the crystal itself is white-radiant at its core, transitioning outward through cyan into deep emerald glass panels

CONTEXT: Full-frame background filling edge-to-edge corner-to-corner; the pane functions as atmospheric surface and symbolic field simultaneously; the concentric ring geometry divides the glass into nested bands separated by thick black lead lines in the manner of a Gothic rose window or altarpiece

COLOR: White radiant core at the crystal center; hot-springs emerald (#2DB56B) saturating the mid-ring glass panels; shelf light blue (#4A90C5) cyan in the inner transitional rings; deep ocean blue (#1E4A85) anchoring the outermost border panels; warm parchment (#F5EDD8) at the aged frame edges

DETAILS: Jewel-toned glass transmitting light; lead lines thick and precise; vibrant clean glass panels; no cracks or breakage; faint foxing at outermost parchment border only
